title: 第5章 尘心洗却污浊念精神问鼎无上天第6章 狠狠的打脸 天道顿悟帝路坦途
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
“我早就该看出来了，这个山野孽障果然包藏祸心，竟然瞒着我们结党自立，绝对是想分裂宗门！”
莫流苏极度阴沉着脸，丝丝缕缕的杀意散发了出来，冰冷浑厚，令人窒息。
即便是白鹤仙子也只能闭上嘴巴，不敢触怒对方。
“我也赞同师尊的想法！”
唐七突然小声说道：“师兄平日里唯唯诺诺，低调的很，没想到却在暗地拉拢了这么多人，我猜测这幅场景也是他早有安排，就是为了加重自己的分量，用来向师尊逼宫！”
“没错，的确是他能做出的事情，我可以作证！”姜玉瑶也在一旁附和，斩钉截铁的说道。
“那他可就要失望了，常言道物以类聚，人以群分，只不过是一群乌合之众罢了，成不了气候，更左右不了我的意志！”
莫流苏冷笑着说道，却让不少长老心头一颤，为了贬低周通，她竟然敢对宗门的其他弟子恶言相向，这绝对不是一个掌权者应有的气度。
她的声音传到了每个人的耳朵中，上百名弟子也听得清清楚楚，却没有丝毫的动摇。
“你们何必如此？为了我这个废人，竟然招惹了这么大的麻烦。”
看着身边这群青春洋溢的少年少女们，即便是周通也忍不住心生感动。
前世他自怨自艾，以为自己是孤家寡人，被整个世界所排挤，却忘了莫流苏等人根本就不是他的整个世界！
在他看不见的角落里，依旧有人崇拜他，仰慕他，憧憬他，将他视为救赎和英雄。
这才是值得他珍重的人，这一世，他将为守护这些人而战！
一念通达，豁然开朗。
他只觉得长久以来绑在身上的枷锁松动了，变得脆弱不堪，轻轻一顿就能化成齑粉。
前世之时，他功参造化，距离巅峰都只有一步之遥，然而就是那短短的距离，限制了他毕生的成就，到死都无法寸进。
曾有高人指点过他，说他的心中尚有缺憾，若不能得到弥补，就无法成就完整大道。
如今，那遗失的拼图终于找到了，他重拾了问鼎武道巅峰的资格。
这一世，他不会留下任何遗憾！

一念天地宽，周通的体内发生了翻天覆地的变化。
这是一场酣畅淋漓的顿悟，也是灵魂的蜕变，由内而外的牵引全身，要助其脱胎换骨，重获新生。
外人不知不晓，看不出任何端倪，但周通知道，接下来他将引发极度绚烂的天地异象，再度踏入修炼之门。
“师兄，你怎么停下了？是有什么不舒服的吗？”
有弟子发现了异常，无比关切的问道。
此话一出，周围的人全都停了下来，紧张的看着周通。
“送君千里，终有一别，你们的心意我领了，该回去了。”
周通满怀笑容的说道，却让身边的人露出了迟疑之色。
“师兄…您的修为…还是让我们再多护送…”
“打住，你们都不听我的话了吗？”
周通板起脸来，让准备坚持的少年少女们戛然而止。
“师兄别生气，我们听你的就是了，但请你记住，不管你遇到什么困难，我们都能帮你分担，
谁如果敢欺凌你，哪怕隔着天涯海角，我们也会把他碎尸万段，即便现在打不过，终有一日，我们也会让其付出代价！”
少年的声音铿锵有力，不只是说给周通，更是对天下人的一个警告。
好让世人知道，周通虽然修为尽失，犹如凡人，但他的师弟师妹们可不是吃素的，谁想对他不利，动手前最好掂量掂量！
“好一群逆徒，竟敢跟我对着干，不好好收拾你们一番还真把我当成了摆设！”
莫流苏捏紧拳头，高耸的胸膛急促地起伏着，彰显着她的不平静。
content_en:
"I should have figured it out a long time ago. This villain in the mountains really has evil intentions. He even formed a party to stand on his own without telling us. He definitely wants to split the sect!"
Mo Liusu's face was extremely gloomy, and traces of murderous intent were radiating out, cold, thick, and suffocating.
Even Fairy Baihe could only keep her mouth shut, not daring to offend the other party.
"I also agree with Master's idea!"
Tang Qi suddenly whispered: "Senior brother is usually submissive and very low-key, but I didn't expect that he has secretly attracted so many people. I guess he had planned this scene in advance, just to increase his weight and use it to force the master to marry him!"
"Yes, it is indeed what he can do, I can testify!" Jiang Yuyao also agreed and said decisively.
"Then he will be disappointed. As the saying goes, birds of a feather flock together, and people flock together. They are just a bunch of rabble. They can't make a difference, let alone control my will!"
Mo Liusu said with a sneer, but it made many elders tremble. In order to belittle Zhou Tong, she dared to speak harshly to other disciples of the sect. This is definitely not the bearing that a person in power should have.
Her voice reached everyone's ears, and hundreds of disciples heard her clearly, but they did not waver in the slightest.
"Why are you doing this? You've gotten into so much trouble for a loser like me."
Looking at the group of youthful young girls around him, even Zhou Tong couldn't help but feel moved.
In his previous life, he felt sorry for himself, thinking that he was alone and ostracized by the whole world, but he forgot that Mo Liusu and others were not his whole world at all!
In the corner that he cannot see, there are still people who worship him, admire him, look forward to him, and regard him as a salvation and a hero.
These are the people who deserve to be cherished by him. In this life, he will fight to protect these people!
A clear thought, suddenly enlightened.
He just felt that the shackles that had been tied to his body for a long time were loosened and became fragile. He could turn into powder with just one click.
In his previous life, he was only one step away from the peak due to his skill in nature. However, that short distance limited his lifelong achievements, and he could not make any progress until his death.
An expert once pointed out to him that he still had shortcomings in his heart, and if they could not be remedied, he would not be able to achieve a complete path.
Now, the missing puzzle piece has finally been found, and he has regained the qualifications to aspire to the pinnacle of martial arts.
In this life, he will not leave any regrets!
As soon as he thought about the world, earth-shaking changes took place in Zhou Tong's body.
This is a heartfelt epiphany and a transformation of the soul. It pulls the whole body from the inside out to help it reborn and regain a new life.
Outsiders don't know and can't see any clues, but Zhou Tong knows that next, he will trigger extremely splendid visions of heaven and earth and step into the door of cultivation again.
"Senior brother, why did you stop? Are you feeling uncomfortable?"
A disciple noticed something unusual and asked with great concern.
As soon as these words came out, everyone around him stopped and looked at Zhou Tong nervously.
"After sending you a thousand miles, we will eventually say goodbye. I accept your thoughts. It's time to go back."
Zhou Tong said with a smile, but the people around him showed hesitation.
"Senior brother... your cultivation level... still allows us to escort you more..."
"Stop it, won't you listen to me?"
Zhou Tong made a serious face and stopped the boys and girls who were about to insist.
"Senior brother, don't be angry, we will just listen to you, but please remember, no matter what difficulties you encounter, we can help you share them.
If anyone dares to bully you, we will tear him into pieces even if we are far away from him. Even if we cannot defeat him now, we will make him pay the price one day! "
The young man's voice was sonorous and powerful, not only speaking to Zhou Tong, but also a warning to everyone in the world.
So that the world can know that although Zhou Tong has lost all his cultivation and is like a mortal, his junior brothers and sisters are not the ones who eat them.If you want to do anything bad to him, you'd better think carefully before taking action!
"What a bunch of rebels, how dare you confront me, and if you don't deal with it properly, you really treat me like a decoration!"
Mo Liusu clenched her fists, and her towering chest rose and fell rapidly, showing her uneasiness.
